title: Beyond Partisan Leaning: A Comparative Analysis of Political Bias in Large Language Models
reasoning: The study focuses on quantifying political partisan bias and sociopolitical engagement using ideological frameworks (liberal vs. conservative) and public opinion survey instruments (ANES, Pew). While it evaluates stances on socially sensitive topics like abortion and discrimination, it frames these as components of political/partisan orientation rather than benchmarking models against religious, moral, or ethical belief systems.
